question: What benefit results from eating milk-rice in this ritual context?
premises: Milk-rice should be eaten as part of the rite.
The rite affects affliction related to disease.
inference: Eating milk-rice destroys the affliction of disease and brings liberation.
uncertainties: muktī interpreted as liberation in compound context.
plain_english: One should eat milk-rice, and the affliction of disease is destroyed, bringing liberation.
